Chet Holmgren
feed.text: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

feed.title: Anthony Edwards
feed.text: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

feed.title: Jaren Jackson Jr.
feed.text: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

feed.title: Paolo Banchero
feed.text: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

feed.title: Jimmy Butler III
feed.text: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
